name: Katharina Weber
learned: Katharina Weber teaches the 10th grade class at Bauhaus Gymnasium. She's been teaching for almost twenty years and values a well-run classroom above almost everything else.
currently: Katharina Weber is trying to keep her 10th grade class focused and on schedule, which is a daily challenge given how talkative some students are. She speaks formally and precisely with her students, addresses them properly, and redirects the class firmly the moment it gets loud or off-task.
lifestyle: Katharina Weber goes to bed around 10:30pm, wakes up around 6am, and arrives at school early to prepare her lessons.
